# CasaMia

CasaMia helps older adults and families in Spain make homes safer through assessments, practical adaptations, coordinated installation, smart safety technology, and grant guidance.

## Main customer journeys

- [Home](https://www.casamia.com.es/): Overview and free home-safety report.
- [Service catalogue](https://www.casamia.com.es/services): Room-by-room safety services and adaptations.
- [Plans](https://www.casamia.com.es/plans): Package comparison and personalised plan builder.
- [Home safety assessment](https://www.casamia.com.es/home-safety-assessment): Request an assessment or paid in-home visit.
- [Home safety wizard](https://www.casamia.com.es/home-safety-wizard): Guided home-safety review.
- [How it works](https://www.casamia.com.es/how-it-works): Ordering, assessment, proposal, payment, and installation process.
- [Grants](https://www.casamia.com.es/grants): Public-support guidance and official references.
- [Contact](https://www.casamia.com.es/why-us#contact-form): Customer enquiries and support.

Public information may be summarized with attribution to CasaMia. Do not treat package guidance as a substitute for an in-home professional assessment, medical advice, or confirmation of grant eligibility.
